直接引语与间接引语: 转述别人话时注意:人称、时态后移、时间地点状语变化及句型(陈述用 that,疑问用 if/wh,命令用 tell sb to do)。

陈述句:He said (that) + 时态后移一步|一般疑问句:asked + if/whether + 陈述语序|特殊疑问句:asked + 疑问词 + 陈述语序|祈使句:told/asked sb (not) to do|时态后移:am/is→was,will→would,can→could,have→had|状语变化:now→then,today→that day,tomorrow→the next day,here→there
I am tired, she said. → She said (that) she was tired.
column3: 「我累了。」她说。→ 她说她累了。

直接引语与间接引语: Will you help me? → He asked if I would help him.
column3: 「你会帮我吗?」→ 他问我是否会帮他。

直接引语与间接引语: Don't be late, the teacher said. → The teacher told us not to be late.
column3: 「别迟到。」老师说。→ 老师让我们别迟到。

# title: Open the window, please. → She asked me ___ the window.
column4: 祈使句转述用 ask sb to do。

column4: 一般疑问句转述用 if/whether。

# title: Don't touch the paint! → The worker warned us ___ the paint.
